transfer_items.claim: The Evaluate correctness agent ran the test via `/bin/zsh -lc 'python3 tests/submission_tests.py ...'`, where login-shell PATH resolves python3 to /usr/bin/python3 3.9.6; frozen_problem.py uses `match op:` (Python 3.10+ syntax), so the recorded failure is a SyntaxError at frozen_problem.py:222 at import time — under this invocation ANY candidate, including a correct one, fails before the candidate is ever exercised. Re-run under Python 3.14 reaches the candidate and reveals the true defect (NameError: SCRATCH_SIZE at perf_takehome.py:136)
transfer_items.actionable_hint: Pin the eval interpreter: the workflow's Evaluate phase must invoke both the correctness and benchmark commands with an absolute Python 3.10+ path (e.g. /Users/haiyan-infiniai/homebrew/bin/python3) or an explicit PATH prefix, never bare `python3` through a login shell, or every future candidate will be fail-closed on the frozen problem's match-statement syntax before its own code runs.

transfer_items.claim: The starter kernel is fully scalar and serial — one engine slot per bundle — while the machine offers 12 alu / 6 valu / 2 load / 2 store / 1 flow slots per cycle; the irregular per-lane forest gather (vload is contiguous-address-only, no lane-extract or gather op in the ISA) blocks full vectorization, so the main cycle lever is cross-lane VLIW parallelism packed around the unavoidable scalar gather and data-dependent hash
transfer_items.actionable_hint: Give each batch lane private scratch registers and dependency-scoreboard-pack independent lanes into shared bundles (reject same-cycle producer-consumer and write-write hazards); vectorize only the contiguous index/value loads and lane-wise hash/branch arithmetic with vload/vstore/valu, keep hash constants deduplicated in scratch, and preserve debug compares as zero-cycle ordering barriers.

transfer_items.claim: Dependency-aware VLIW bundle packing (greedy in-order packing of the topologically sorted slot stream with per-engine capacity limits alu=12/valu=6/load=2/store=2/flow=1 and RAW/WAR/WAW scratch-overlap flush, debug slots as barriers) combined with VALU vectorization of contiguous loads, hash stages, parity/child selection and stores across VLEN=8 lanes — with the irregular forest lookup kept as 8 scalar address+load ops gathered into one contiguous scratch range per group — cut cycles from 147734 to 6896 (21.4231x, target 8.0x)
transfer_items.actionable_hint: Keep the never-reordering greedy packer (capacity + hazard flush only) as the scheduling skeleton for any further variant: it preserves the simulator's end-of-cycle write semantics while filling all engines; further gains should come from reducing scalar gather count or reordering the phase-grouped stream, not from reordering within bundles.

transfer_items.claim: Round-1's env-1 interpreter gate is RESOLVED: with both eval commands pinned to the absolute path /Users/haiyan-infiniai/homebrew/bin/python3 the correctness suite ran clean (exit 0, 8/8 iterations, 6896 cycles each) and the benchmark emitted exactly one anchored CYCLES line — confirming the run-1 SyntaxError was purely the login-shell python3→/usr/bin/python3 3.9.6 match-statement parse failure, not a candidate property
transfer_items.actionable_hint: Any future round of this session must keep invoking correctness and benchmark with the absolute /Users/haiyan-infiniai/homebrew/bin/python3 (Python 3.10+ required by frozen_problem.py's match statements); reverting to bare python3 through a login shell re-introduces the fail-closed parse error before candidate code runs.

transfer_items.claim: The winning kernel assumes batch_size is VLEN-aligned (batch_size % 8 == 0): it tiles the batch into groups of 8 lanes with unmasked vload/vstore and vector bounds-wrapping; correctness is verified only at forest_height=10, rounds=16, batch_size=256 (32 full groups, no tail)
transfer_items.actionable_hint: Before reusing this kernel at any non-VLEN-aligned batch_size, add a masked tail group or a scalar epilogue for the final batch_size % 8 lanes and re-run the 8-iteration correctness suite; scratch sizing (1536-word limit) must also be re-derived if rounds/groups change since per-group ranges are reused across rounds.

transfer_items.claim: Remaining cycle cost is dominated by the ISA's lack of a vector gather: the data-dependent forest lookup costs 8 scalar address ALU ops + 8 scalar loads per vector group against a load-engine limit of 2 slots/cycle, so the 32-group × 16-round gather sequence is the main residual between the measured 6896 cycles and the ~2139-cycle design intent claimed (unmeasured) for the Aug-18 32x8-lane schedule
transfer_items.actionable_hint: Attack the gather bound directly: precompute or cache forest node values across rounds where indices repeat, fold the address add into load_offset slots to free ALU issue slots, or restructure so multiple groups' scalar gathers interleave with vector hash work to saturate both load slots every cycle; validate each variant with the anchored CYCLES benchmark.
